toolsPage.intro: Free tools that run entirely in your browser — files are never uploaded to a server.
toolsPage.searchPlaceholder: Search tools — pdf, image, qr, json...

common.clickToSelectFile: or click to select a file
common.clickToSelectFiles: or click to select files (multiple files supported)
common.dragToReorder: Drag the handle to change the page order
common.imageFormats: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP and AVIF · multiple files supported
common.addImage: Please add at least one image

pdfToPptx.title: PDF TO PPTX
pdfToPptx.intro: Turn PDF files into a PowerPoint presentation. Every page becomes a slide, several PDFs can be merged into one deck, and the conversion runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
pdfToPptx.dragOrder: Drag the handle to change the slide order
pdfToPptx.addFile: Please add at least one PDF file
pdfToPptx.stillReading: Still reading PDF files. Please wait a moment

pdfToImages.title: PDF TO IMAGES
pdfToImages.intro: Render every page of a PDF as a PNG, JPG or WebP image. One page downloads on its own, more than one arrives as a ZIP — and the file never leaves your browser.
pdfToImages.name: Name

mergePdf.title: MERGE PDF
mergePdf.intro: Join several PDF files into one document, in the order you choose. Pages are copied without being re-encoded, and nothing is uploaded.
mergePdf.addTwo: Please add at least two PDF files
mergePdf.failed: Failed to merge the PDF files

splitPdf.title: SPLIT PDF
splitPdf.intro: Extract the pages you need into a new PDF, or break a document into one file per page. Pages keep their original quality and nothing is uploaded.

compressPdf.title: COMPRESS PDF
compressPdf.intro: Make a PDF small enough to email or upload. Pages are re-drawn as compressed images, so scans shrink a lot — and nothing is uploaded.
compressPdf.alreadySmall: This document was already efficient — it is mostly text rather than images, so turning the pages into pictures does not help. Keep the original.

organizePdf.title: ORGANIZE PDF
organizePdf.intro: See every page as a thumbnail, then reorder, rotate or delete pages and save the result. Pages keep their original quality and nothing is uploaded.
organizePdf.noPages: There are no pages left to save

imagesToPdf.title: IMAGES TO PDF
imagesToPdf.intro: Put photos, scans or screenshots into a single PDF — one image per page, on A4, Letter or pages shaped like the image itself. Nothing is uploaded.

imageConverter.title: IMAGE CONVERTER
imageConverter.intro: Convert images between PNG, JPG and WebP, resize them, and compress them to a smaller file. Several at once, all in your browser.
imageConverter.sameSettings: Every image is converted with the same settings

pptxViewer.title: PPTX VIEWER
pptxViewer.intro: Open a PowerPoint (.pptx) file and page through its slides without installing anything. The file is read in your browser and never leaves your device.
pptxViewer.hint: or click to select a file. Everything stays in your browser

qrCode.title: QR CODE
qrCode.intro: Make a QR code for a link, text, Wi-Fi network, email or phone number. The value is encoded directly, so the code never expires and no one counts your scans.
qrCode.textPlaceholder: Anything you want the code to carry
qrCode.subject: Subject (optional)
qrCode.empty: Fill in the fields to see your QR code
qrCode.failed: Failed to create the QR code

uuidGenerator.title: UUID GENERATOR
uuidGenerator.intro: Generate random v4 or time-ordered v7 identifiers, one or thousands at a time. They come from your browser's cryptographic generator and are never sent anywhere.
uuidGenerator.checkPlaceholder: Paste an identifier to see whether it is valid
uuidGenerator.invalid: Not a valid UUID — it needs 32 hexadecimal digits with a version between 1 and 8.
uuidGenerator.badCount: Enter how many you want, as a whole number

base64.title: BASE64
base64.intro: Encode text or a file to base64 and decode it back, with the URL-safe variant when the value has to live in a link. Converted in your browser.
base64.anyFile: any file — it is read on your device
base64.encodePlaceholder: Type or paste the text to encode

hashGenerator.title: HASH GENERATOR
hashGenerator.intro: Generate SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 for text or a file, and check a download against its published checksum. Hashed on your device.
hashGenerator.textPlaceholder: Type or paste the text to hash
hashGenerator.anyFile: any file — large files are handled at full speed
hashGenerator.comparePlaceholder: Paste the checksum you were given
hashGenerator.match: Match — this is the {{algorithm}} checksum of your {{source}}.
hashGenerator.noMatch: No match. Download the file again — an interrupted transfer is the usual cause.

colorConverter.title: COLOR CONVERTER
colorConverter.intro: Convert a colour between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV and CMYK, check whether text will be readable on it, and pull out its lighter and darker versions.
colorConverter.invalid: That is not a colour we can read. Try a hex code, or an rgb() or hsl() value.

jsonFormatter.title: JSON FORMATTER
jsonFormatter.intro: Lay out JSON so you can read it, minify it back down, and see exactly where an invalid document breaks. Parsed in your browser, never sent anywhere.

csvToJson.title: CSV TO JSON
csvToJson.intro: Turn a CSV or TSV export into JSON, or a JSON array back into CSV. Quoted fields and custom delimiters are handled, and nothing is uploaded.
csvToJson.dropHint: {{format}} — drop a file here to load it

textDiff.title: TEXT COMPARE
textDiff.intro: Compare two versions line by line and see exactly what was added, removed and left alone. Both texts stay in your browser.
textDiff.originalLabel: Original — drop a text file here to load it
textDiff.pasteFirst: Paste something into both boxes first

wordCounter.title: WORD COUNTER
wordCounter.intro: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs as you type, with reading time and the words you lean on most. Nothing you write is uploaded.
wordCounter.placeholder: Type or paste your text here

calculator.atLeastTwo: Please enter at least two different numbers
calculator.smallest: {{lcm}} is the smallest number that is divisible by both {{a}} and {{b}}

input.numbersOnly: Only numbers and commas are allowed
input.doubleComma: Invalid format: consecutive commas are not allowed
input.edgeComma: Invalid format: comma at start or end is not allowed

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: This address does not point at anything. The link may be out of date, or the page may have been renamed.
